title: "mypackage"

One or two sentences on what the package does and who it is for.

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/HI-IDN/mypackage.git
mypackage --help
```

## Why

Explain the problem the package solves, and what makes it different from doing it by hand.

## What it deliberately does not do

- List the things that are out of scope.
- Say what users should not expect from it.
